purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Oshima OP-303 is a pocket creasing machine manufactured by Oshima Taiwan. It is used to fold, crease, and hot-press pocket edges before the pocket is attached to garments. The machine helps produce a more consistent pocket shape compared with manual folding and ironing.

title: Oshima OP-303 Pocket Creaser
subtitle: Dual-Station Pocket Creasing / Hot-Pressing Machine
overviewDescription: The Oshima OP-303 is a fixed pocket creasing and hot-pressing machine manufactured by Oshima Taiwan. It uses a shaped pocket mold, folding mechanism, heat, and pressure to fold and crease pocket edges before the pocket is attached to garments. The dual-station design allows two pocket-forming stations for higher production output.

classificationTable.value: Fixed pocket creasing / pocket hot-pressing machine
Folding and creasing pocket edges before pocket attaching operation
Shirt pockets, jeans pockets, and similar pocket-forming work
Official public information confirms electronic thermostat control. PLC is not mentioned in official public OP-303 information.
No authentic public OP-303 parts-list PDF was found online. Official parts book should be requested from Oshima or an authorized dealer.

technicalSpecs.value: 4 kW (verify from actual machine nameplate before electrical maintenance)

workingPrinciples.heading: 1. Mold-Based Shaping
workingPrinciples.description: The operator installs the correct pocket mold for the required pocket size and shape. The mold gives the pocket its fixed and repeatable form. Mold replacement takes approximately 3 minutes.

workingPrinciples.heading: 2. Folding Mechanism
workingPrinciples.description: The folding plate and edge folder turn the pocket fabric edge around the mold into the required shape. This replaces manual folding and ensures consistent edge alignment across all pieces.

workingPrinciples.heading: 3. Heat and Pressure Creasing
workingPrinciples.description: The heated pressing plate applies heat (controlled by electronic thermostat to ±3°C accuracy) and pressure to fix the crease permanently. The heat sets the fold so the pocket retains its shape during the sewing operation.

workingPrinciples.heading: 4. Dual-Station Operation
workingPrinciples.description: The machine has two working stations (left and right). While one pocket is being pressed, the operator can prepare the next pocket on the other station, increasing production output to 300–450 pieces per hour.

maintenance.definition: Mold loose, wrong fabric placement, folding plate misaligned
maintenance.action: Check mold fixing, clean mold base, adjust folding plate.

maintenance.definition: Low temperature, weak pressure, short pressing time
maintenance.action: Check heater, temperature, pressure, and cycle setting.

maintenance.definition: Excess temperature, dirty hot plate, long pressing time
maintenance.action: Reduce temperature, clean pressing surface, check heat setting.

maintenance.definition: Heater, thermostat, relay/SSR, contactor, or wiring fault
maintenance.action: Check heater resistance, thermostat output, SSR/relay, and wiring.

maintenance.definition: Sensor loose, thermostat fault, electrical switching issue
maintenance.action: Check sensor, thermostat, SSR/relay, and terminal tightness.

maintenance.definition: Mold, heater, pressure, or folding condition different between stations
maintenance.action: Compare both stations and adjust equally.

finalNotes:
• PLC: Technicians mentioned that the machine may use a PLC, but this is not yet confirmed from official resources.
• Usage: The machine only runs when needed and remains idle most of the time. During inspection, the machine was observed in an idle condition.
• Heater Capacity: 4 kW according to Oshima English official page and catalog. Always verify from actual machine nameplate before electrical maintenance.
• Parts Book: No authentic public OP-303 parts-list PDF was found online. Request the official parts book directly from Oshima or an authorized dealer.
